copy.hook: The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.91% on Nov. 24. 🔢

facts:
Data fetched 2026-11-25 from the U.S. Department of the Treasury daily par yield curve CSV, 10 Yr column:
11/24/2026 = 4.91. 10/23/2026 = 5.00 (the last trading day on or before 10/24, which was a Saturday). The last 60 trading days run from
08/28/2026 (4.73, the lowest) to 11/24/2026; the highest is 5.31 on 10/05/2026.
Treasury page: the par yield curve relates the par yield on a security to its time to maturity and is based on closing market bid prices on
the most recently auctioned Treasury securities in the over-the-counter market.

The publisher's records and SLE_CONTENT_LEDGER.md were read on 2026-11-25: this post was not published before. The owner asked for it to be prepared for the days before 2026-12-04.
slides_text:
IMAGE: The Number, Rates. The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.91% on Nov. 24. A month earlier, on Oct. 23, it was 5.00%.
Chart: daily, last 60 trading days, percent, Aug. 28 to Nov. 24, low 4.73%, high 5.31%, last 4.91%.
What is it? The 10-year point on the Treasury's par yield curve, based on closing market bid prices of the most recently auctioned Treasury securities.
FOOTER: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, daily par yield curve rates, data through 11/24/2026. Educational content only. Not financial or investment advice.
